morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语将其作为完整借词使用；bi- 和 -dari 不是这里的马来语词缀。全词重叠可表示复数。

senses.zh_definition: 仙女；天女：宗教描述或神话传说中居于天堂、天界的女性形象。
senses.en_definition: A celestial maiden or female divine being inhabiting heaven or a mythical celestial realm.
senses.ms_definition: Dewi di syurga atau di kayangan.
senses.nuances: 具体所指随宗教或故事背景而异。伊斯兰天堂语境中可译为 houri，民间故事中常译为 celestial maiden；不宜一概等同于 malaikat（天使）。马来语释义据 [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=342968&keyword=bidadari)。

collocations.en: a celestial maiden from the heavens

senses.zh_definition: 仙女般的美人；比喻容貌极其美丽的女子。
senses.en_definition: An exceptionally beautiful woman, figuratively compared to a celestial maiden.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，常带诗意、爱慕或夸赞色彩；本义并不要求所指女子同时具有善良、温柔等品格。马来语释义据 [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=342968&keyword=bidadari)。

collocations.en: as beautiful as a celestial maiden

etymology.historical_story: Bidadari ultimately comes from Sanskrit vidyādharī, a female supernatural being. Its history reflects South Asian influence on the vocabulary and storytelling traditions of the Malay world. In Malay, the word names a maiden of heaven or the celestial realm and also supplies a poetic comparison for an exceptionally beautiful woman. These uses preserve different cultural settings within one familiar word. [Linguistic source](https://brill.com/display/book/9789004529458/9789004529458_webready_content_text.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 bi-da-da-ri 四拍朗读，想象仙女轻盈走来；把整个声音连到“仙女、美若天仙”的画面。
